profiles.purpose: CASC POC development and evaluation host (native Metal inference)

toolchain.system_python: 3.9.6; do not use for the API
toolchain.llama_server: pinned b11149 in ~/.cache/psychiatryeduai/runtimes/b11149; not global PATH

constraints.inference: native llama.cpp Metal; CPU fallback for diagnosis
constraints.speech: local speech recognition (Phase 2); no audio retained by default

service_objectives.scope: Provisional single-user role-play target; Phase 4 measures per-stage and end-to-end turn latency

notes: p3_observations are grounded-QA measurements from before the CASC pivot (report at git tag pre-casc-archive); they indicate runtime speed, not role-play performance.

latency.scope: Warm resident models, two passes; throughput includes prompt processing

p3_observations.rss_caveat: RSS may double-count shared pages; excludes GPU allocations and Docker VM. System pressure/swap and separate container usage accompany these samples.
p3_observations.cold_start_caveat: First application answer after fresh native processes; file cache warmed by SHA verification; server startup includes built-in warmup
